elements.element: The Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York.
elements.evidence: Section 11 expressly provides that the Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with New York law.

elements.element: The designated courts include the state courts located in New York County, New York.
elements.evidence: Section 19 designates the “state ... courts in New York County, New York.”

elements.element: The designated courts include the federal courts located in New York County, New York.
elements.evidence: Section 19 designates the “federal courts in New York County, New York.”

elements.element: The jurisdiction of the designated New York County state and federal courts is exclusive for all covered disputes.
elements.evidence: Although Section 19 generally provides for exclusive jurisdiction, it permits either party to seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court of competent jurisdiction. This express exception means New York County jurisdiction is not exclusive for all covered disputes and remedies.

elements.element: The Agreement is governed by the laws of Delaware, California, or England and Wales.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause selects New York law, not any listed fallback law.

elements.element: Disputes are assigned to courts in the forum corresponding to the selected fallback law: Delaware courts for Delaware law, California courts for California law, or London courts for the laws of England and Wales.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause selects New York County courts and permits temporary-injunction proceedings elsewhere; it does not select any permitted fallback court package.

result.reason: The redline correctly adopts New York law and identifies the state and federal courts in New York County, but the temporary-injunctive-relief carveout defeats the required exclusive-jurisdiction position. That carveout is not necessary to reach either accepted position and materially qualifies the requested forum exclusivity. No fallback law-and-court package is selected.
